summary_en: 2.3M shares (4.8% of S/O), ¥2.5B upper limit, open-market acquisition, Aug 3 - Sep 30, 2026. Rationale: capital efficiency and per-share value accretion.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On July 31, 2026, the board of Tanseisha (ticker 9743, TSE Prime) authorized a treasury stock buyback under the Companies Act Article 165(2) and Article 156. The company will acquire up to 2.3 million ordinary shares (4.8% of outstanding shares excluding treasury) for a maximum of ¥2.5 billion. Purchases will occur via open-market trading on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between August 3 and September 30, 2026. The stated purpose is to enhance capital efficiency and improve per-share value through share count reduction. As of April 30, 2026, the company held 318,491 treasury shares against 48,105,580 shares outstanding (ex-treasury).
